evidence: No residue from other work: all five prompt.md files and app_context.md are rewritten for HireOps (template CHANGE_ME placeholders replaced); a grep of tests/ and instruction.md for other product names and non-local URLs finds only localhost/127.0.0.1 and the harbor-rewardkit pip line in tests/Dockerfile. Re-derived against seed_data.json and the brief, every concrete fact the prompts state is accurate: URL http://localhost:3000 (brief port 3000); password Hireops!2026 and all 10 account emails/roles in app_context.md:8-19 match seed users and instruction.md:19; screens Board/Conversations/Activity plus candidate applications view (app_context.md:23-25) match instruction.md:11; six stages match hireops_rules.md:43; 'three jobs' and Noor's Platform Engineer conversation '120 messages' match seed (APP-101 has 120 messages); Data Analyst (Finance Systems, manager Bill Okafor USR-MGR2), Product Designer (Design, manager Yuki Tanaka USR-MGR3, as functional/prompt.md:21 says) and Platform Engineer (Infrastructure, manager Ingrid) match; hro_intake_restart's seeded order (Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi; Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz) and Noor's note text match seed positions and notes[0]; hro_candidate statuses (Noor PE Interviewing, PD Application received; Tomas DA In review) match stages and candidate_status_labels; hro_unread_seen 'Lena 1' matches (APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena read_count 2, message 3 from USR-REC3); restart_app matches restart_mcp.py:14; functional judge.toml comment '61 in all' re-summed = 61. Cross-references ('graded only in Functional', 'hro_pol_session_resume', 'which hro_messaging grades', 'opening is graded only in hro_intake_restart') point to existing criteria. Colderwater lessons checked for this row: checker-not-fixer paragraph present in all 5 prompts (lesson 6); no public internet address in any prompt (lesson 13); modifier-key hold wording at app_context.md:33-35 (lesson 8); timed-observation/void/repeat text identical in functional/prompt.md:29 and polish/prompt.md:18 (lessons 7/14); 'Report every step' in all three scored prompts (lesson 9); assembled prompt sizes are small (largest: functional prompt 8640 B + app_context 1921 B + one criterion), far under 128 KB (lesson 10). DEFECT (prompt/criterion inconsistency about shared seeded state): hro_unread_seen (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:121) relies on a seeded fact and asserts 'the starting read markers give her 1. No other session opens Lena's conversation.' with bar 'Lena's count is 1.' Only the Polish prompt protects that conversation ('Never use Lena Fischer's conversation.', polish/prompt.md:24). The Functional prompt.md, the only shared text every individual-mode functional session sees (mode = "individual", judge.toml:3), has no such rule, and hro_readonly_roles (judge.toml:94, listed before hro_unread_seen) tells Rafael to do 'one conversation read (open any conversation) and one message send (a suffixed message in that conversation)'. Rafael may write in every conversation (hireops_rules.md:136), so if that session picks Lena's Product Designer conversation the send raises Lena's unread to 2 and a correct app fails hro_unread_seen (weight 3.5 of 61). Lena's conversation is a plausible pick: its last seeded message (2026-07-29T11:15Z) ties for most recent with Tomas's. The claim 'No other session opens Lena's conversation' is not guaranteed by the prompt set, and the functional prompt is inconsistent with the polish prompt about the same protected record. This overlaps the shared-state/independence rows; it is reported here because this row requires every instance. Not exercised: no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope).
counterexample: Golden (correct) app, functional suite run in criterion order: the hro_readonly_roles session, free to 'open any conversation', opens Lena Fischer's Product Designer conversation as Rafael and sends its suffixed message (a legal, successful recruiter send). The later hro_unread_seen session signs in as Lena and reads unread 2, not the quoted 1, so the bar 'Lena's count is 1' fails and the whole 3.5-weight criterion scores 0 for a conforming app.
suggested_fix: Add 'Never open or write in Lena Fischer's conversation; another criterion reads its seeded unread count.' to the Shared state section of tests/scored/functional/prompt.md (matching polish/prompt.md:24), and/or make hro_readonly_roles use the conversation of a card on its own new job; then re-review the rows the change touches.
